{{armor art infobox | profession = Warrior | campaign = [[Eye of the North]] | specialgallery = warrior Ironfist Gauntlets }} '''Warrior Ironfist Gauntlets''' is a [[prestige armor]] piece available in the Eye of the North expansion.
